calculations.calculation: Money Consciousness Shift Index minus Money Consciousness Index (Pre).
calculations.interpretation: The difference is in points on the original 1–10 rating scale. A positive value means the first rating is higher; zero means the ratings are equal; a negative value means it is lower. These are your own ratings, not an assessment of skill or proof of programme effect.
